era_note: Nantes and Lac-Megantic, Quebec, 2012-2018; centre of gravity 22:50 on 5 July 2013 to 01:15 on 6 July 2013. Per episode_spec forbidden_subjects, no victims, no funerals, no movie explosions, no steam or passenger trains, no US flags or highway signs. Per forbidden_claims, no Short blames the three acquitted men or names them (none is named or described), none says a second crew member or two-person operation would have prevented it, the seven applied hand brakes are always given against the investigation's seventeen-to-twenty-six range and the railway's own nine (never one figure alone), no deliberate mislabelling is asserted, and every figure spoken is a verified script sentence backed by the FACTS_LEDGER.

shorts.angle: The securement check was done, and done as understood - but it was performed with the independent brakes still active, so the thing holding the train during the test was not the thing being tested. A check that cannot fail protects nobody.
shorts.avoids: Names none of the three acquitted men and blames no individual - the hook line is the script's own negation, this was not a man skipping a check. The seven hand brakes are given against both the railway's own nine and the investigation's seventeen-to-twenty-six range, never alone. Does not mention single-person operation. The forty-seven dead appear only in the film's own summary sentence.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: Who was standing in that yard at the end of the shift, and what happened to the engine two hours later?
shorts.loop_join: The close - eighteen separate things had gone wrong - lands back on the hook's claim that this was never one man skipping one check.

lines.text: This was not a man skipping a check. The check was done. It was the check itself that could not fail.
source_lines: This was not a man skipping a check.
The check was done.
It was the check itself that could not fail.

lines.text: A parked train is held by two different things. The first is the air brake, which needs a running engine. The second is the hand brake.
source_lines: A parked train is held by two different things, and the difference between them is the whole of this film.
The first is the air brake.
That pressure is made by a compressor, and the compressor is driven by a running locomotive engine.
The second is the hand brake.

lines.text: Hand brakes were applied to seven, out of a train of seventy-eight vehicles. The railway's own minimum, by the railway's own arithmetic, was nine.
source_lines: Seven, out of a train of seventy-eight vehicles.
The railway's own minimum, by the railway's own arithmetic, was nine.

lines.text: The investigation concluded that the real number was a minimum of seventeen, and possibly as many as twenty-six.
source_lines: And the investigation, working out what it would actually have taken to hold ten thousand tons on that grade with no air, concluded that the real number was a minimum of seventeen, and possibly as many as twenty-six.

lines.text: But none of that was left to judgement, because there was a test.
source_lines: But none of that was left to judgement, because there was a test.

lines.text: The test was performed. It was performed with the independent brakes still active. So the thing holding the train during the test was not the thing being tested.
source_lines: The test was performed.
It was performed with the independent brakes still active.
So the thing holding the train during the test was not the thing being tested.

lines.text: The train held. Of course it held. And because it held, nobody in that yard had any way of knowing that seven hand brakes were not enough.
source_lines: The train held.
Of course it held.
And because it held, nobody in that yard had any way of knowing that seven hand brakes were not enough.

lines.text: At the end of it, forty-seven people were dead, and eighteen separate things had gone wrong.
source_lines: At the end of it, forty-seven people were dead, and eighteen separate things had gone wrong.

shorts.angle: All sixty-three derailed tank cars were in compliance with their specification, and ninety-four per cent of them opened - compliance describes what was asked of a car on the day it was approved, not how strong it is.
shorts.avoids: Blames nobody; no person appears in it at all. Does not say the crude was deliberately mislabelled - the cargo is not mentioned. Does not mention the securement, the crew, or the trial. Every figure - sixty-three, seventy-eight per cent, fifty-nine, ninety-four per cent, thirty-seven - is a verified script sentence backed by the FACTS_LEDGER.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: What was in those cars, and did the shipping papers say what it really was?
shorts.loop_join: The Board's closing line about impact resistance answers the hook's promise that the tank cars are their own kind of answer.

lines.text: Before the investigation reached any question of who did what, it looked at the tank cars, and what it found there is its own kind of answer.
source_lines: Before the investigation reached any question of who did what, it looked at the tank cars, and what it found there is its own kind of answer.

lines.text: All sixty-three of the derailed cars had been built to a single specification. Seventy-eight per cent of them were less than five years old.
source_lines: All sixty-three of the derailed cars had been built to a single specification, between nineteen eighty and twenty twelve.
Seventy-eight per cent of them were less than five years old.

lines.text: Fifty-nine of the sixty-three were breached. Ninety-four per cent. Thirty-seven of them were holed through the shell.
source_lines: Fifty-nine of the sixty-three were breached.
Ninety-four per cent.
Thirty-seven of them were holed through the shell.

lines.text: All sixty-three derailed tank cars were in compliance with the specification requirement that was in effect at the time of their approval and construction.
source_lines: All sixty-three derailed tank cars were in compliance with the specification requirement that was in effect at the time of their approval and construction.

lines.text: They were legal. They were current. Ninety-four per cent of them opened.
source_lines: They were legal.
They were current.
Ninety-four per cent of them opened.

lines.text: Compliance is not a description of how strong something is. It is a description of what was asked of it, on the day it was approved.
source_lines: Compliance is not a description of how strong something is.
It is a description of what was asked of it, on the day it was approved.

lines.text: A car built in nineteen eighty and a car built in twenty twelve were both in compliance, because the requirement had not moved between them.
source_lines: A car built in nineteen eighty and a car built in twenty twelve were both in compliance, because the requirement had not moved between them.

lines.text: The damage clearly indicated that product release could have been reduced had the tank car shells and heads been more impact-resistant.
source_lines: The damage clearly indicated that product release could have been reduced had the tank car shells and heads been more impact-resistant.

shorts.angle: The firefighters did the correct thing and the fire went out - and with every engine shut down, the air holding a ten-thousand-ton train leaked away for an hour and a half in an empty yard, until at fifty-eight minutes past midnight the train began to move.
shorts.avoids: Blames nobody: the fire service is stated to have acted correctly in the script's own words, no railway employee is named or described, and the report's sentence - no decision was documented - is quoted as the record's own finding, not as an accusation. Does not mention the deaths or the town's destruction; the Short ends where the runaway begins. Every time, speed and pressure figure is a verified script sentence.
shorts.funnel_question_left_for_longform: What happened when a train doing sixty-five entered a curve built for twenty - and who, if anyone, was ever found responsible?
shorts.loop_join: The close - a town at the bottom - returns to the hook's village and the flames that started the chain.
shorts.era: Nantes, Quebec, Canada, night of 5-6 July 2013

lines.text: Shortly before midnight, in a village called Nantes, somebody looked at a parked locomotive and saw flames on the front of it.
source_lines: Shortly before midnight, in a village called Nantes, somebody looked at a parked locomotive and saw flames on the front of it.

lines.text: The firefighters who arrived did exactly what they were trained to do, and they did it correctly. The fire went out.
source_lines: The firefighters who arrived did exactly what they were trained to do, and they did it correctly.
The fire went out.

lines.text: What nobody in that yard knew was that the engine they were about to switch off was the only thing holding seventy-two tank cars of crude oil above a sleeping town.
source_lines: What nobody standing in that yard knew was that the engine they were about to switch off was the only thing holding seventy-two tank cars of crude oil on the hill above a sleeping town.

lines.text: No decision was documented, after the fire was extinguished, to move the train or to apply additional hand brakes. No decision.
source_lines: No decision was documented, after the fire was extinguished, to move the train or to apply additional hand brakes.
No decision.

lines.text: The pressure holding a ten-thousand-ton train on a descending grade fell, slowly, for about an hour and a half.
source_lines: The pressure holding a ten-thousand-ton train on a descending grade fell, slowly, in an empty yard, with nobody watching it, for about an hour and a half.

lines.text: At fifty-eight minutes past midnight and twenty-one seconds, the train began to move. One mile an hour. There was no person.
source_lines: At fifty-eight minutes past midnight and twenty-one seconds, the train began to move.
One mile an hour.
There was no person.

lines.text: Seventeen minutes later it was doing sixty-five miles an hour.
source_lines: Seventeen minutes later it was doing sixty-five miles an hour.

lines.text: Seven point two miles of descending grade, no driver, no brake that was coming back, and a town at the bottom.
source_lines: Seven point two miles of descending grade, no driver, no brake that was coming back, and a town at the bottom.
